scope: Oblique beta release notices only; no fluent review claimed.

entries.source: Choose Oblique in AI viewpoint for an angled illustration of your whole design.

drafts.zu: Khetha i-Oblique ku-AI viewpoint ukuze ubone umdwebo wawo wonke umklamo wakho ubukwa nge-engeli.
drafts.st: Kgetha Oblique ho AI viewpoint bakeng sa setshwantsho sa moralo wa hao kaofela se shebilweng ka lehlakore.
drafts.ts: Hlawula Oblique eka AI viewpoint ku vona xifaniso xa pulani ya wena hinkwato xi langutiwe hi le tlhelo.
drafts.ve: Khethani Oblique kha AI viewpoint uri ni vhone tshifanyiso tsha pulane yaṋu yoṱhe tsho sedzwa nga thungo.

entries.source: The app gathers your layout, photo and terrain; use the top-down plan for measurements.

drafts.zu: Uhlelo lulungisa umklamo owugcinile, isithombe sendawo nolwazi lomhlaba olutholakalayo; sebenzisa ipulani ebukwa phezulu ukuze ulinganise.
drafts.st: App e lokisa moralo o bolokilweng, foto ya sebaka le tlhahisoleseding ya mobu e fumanehang; sebedisa moralo o shebilweng hodimo bakeng sa ditekanyo.
drafts.ts: App yi lulamisa pulani leyi hlayisiweke, xifaniso xa ndhawu ni vuxokoxoko bya misava leyi kumekaka; tirhisa pulani leyi langutiweke ehenhla ku pima.
drafts.ve: App i lugisa pulane yo vhulungwaho, tshifanyiso tsha fhethu na zwidodombedzwa zwa mavu zwi re hone; shumisani pulane yo sedzwaho nṱha u kala.
